description: Brazilian Corporate CNPJ KYB Dossier (QSA partners, Simples/MEI, B2B Risk Score), IBGE Geo-CEP lookup, CPF/CNPJ Mod-11 validator, and Central Bank PIX BRCode (EMVCo + CRC16) generator/decoder (0.01 USDC via x402 on Base).

aiSummary.description: Generate an executive B2B compliance summary using Cloudflare Workers AI (default: true).

cep.description: Brazilian postal code (CEP, 8 digits) to enrich address, IBGE municipality code, state UF, and area code (DDD).

cnpj.description: Brazilian corporate tax ID (CNPJ, 14 digits) to fetch full Receita Federal dossier, QSA partners, tax regime (Simples/MEI), and B2B credit/compliance risk score.

documentToValidate.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) to validate mathematical check digits (Mod-11).

pixDecode.description: Raw PIX Copy-and-Paste string (000201...) to parse EMV tags and verify CRC16 integrity.

pixGenerate.description: Generate an official Central Bank of Brazil (BCB EMVCo) PIX Copy-and-Paste payload with CRC16-CCITT checksum.

key.description: PIX key (CPF, CNPJ, Email, Phone +55, or Random UUID)

txid.description: Transaction reference ID (alphanumeric up to 25 chars)

name: br_business_intel
